newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco closes subscription on public T-bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Morocco closes subscription on public T-bond issue.

text.p: Morocco's Finance Ministry on Friday said it closed subscription for a discounted public Treasury bond issue on the Casablanca stock exchange.
"Public subscription for public Treasury bonds at between 8.5 and 9.5 percent interest rate was closed on Friday at 1800 GMT," a ministry official said.
Subscription was opened on Monday, the official said.

The Treasury bonds, called Emprunt National, are listed on the stock exchange as part of the state domestic debt oriented to small investors and will be negotiable on the market from March 31, he added.
The government bonds showed interest rates down 0.5 percent, a market analyst said.
The bonds were issued as follows: one-year bond at 8.5 percent, three-year bond at 9.0 percent and five-year bond at 9.5 percent, the analyst added.
It was not immediately known in value the T-bond amount raised on the Casablanca bourse, officials said.
